# QR encoder

QRCode for JavaScript by Kazuhiko Arase, as distributed in qrcode-terminal 0.12.0 (https://github.com/gtanner/qrcode-terminal). Copied from the installed npm distribution and bundled to ESM without algorithm changes. The upstream MIT notice and distribution license are retained in LICENSE.

The generated bundle renames the internal CommonJS shim identifiers to prevent a second CommonJS transformation by the framework. The QR algorithm and data tables are unchanged.
